source.name: Flash Fire
source.originalDescription: When this Pokémon takes Sp. Atk-based damage from opposing Pokémon, the damage this Pokémon takes is reduced by 20% for 3s, and their next auto attack deals additional damage. This Ability goes on a 10s cooldown after it ends.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Flash Fire は 攻撃・特攻などのステータスを変化させる、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する。

source.name: Incinerate
source.originalDescription: Has the user attack the designated opposing Pokémon with a flame, setting them ablaze and dealing damage over time for 4s. When a Pokémon on the opposing team that's ablaze picks up a Berry, the Berry's effects are halved.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Incinerate は 継続ダメージを与える。

source.name: Will-o-Wisp
source.originalDescription: Has the user shoot a flame in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit, leaving them burned and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s. After using this move, the user's next auto attack becomes a boosted attack.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Will-o-Wisp は やけどを付与する、移動速度を下げる、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。

source.name: Psykaboom
source.originalDescription: Has the user jump up, becoming unstoppable for 1.85s, and charge psychic power for 1s, then create an area that leaves opposing Pokémon unable to act. While the user is charging psychic power, the Unite Move can be used again to adjust the position of the area. The user then fires a ball of flame towards the center of the area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and throwing them away from the center of the area. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Psykaboom は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、相手を打ち上げる、妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
